title: run_demo's live path never copies advance_gate_on — the three gate goldens are blessed/checked with the gate DISABLED
evidence:
cfg := Demo_Replay{
		name = demo.name,
		use_fixture = demo.use_fixture,
		qos_fixture = demo.qos_fixture,
		growth_on = demo.growth_on, // 5.1: run setup — the director's map growth
		session = {goal = demo.win_goal, cap_ms = demo.lose_cap_ms, health_on = demo.health_on, surge_win_pct = demo.surge_win_pct},
	}  — no advance_gate_on here, while load_demo_replay has: `cfg.advance_gate_on = demo.advance_gate_on // 6.2: run setup — re-created identically on replay` (run.odin:688) and demo_apply_setup applies `state.advance_gate_enabled = cfg.advance_gate_on` (run.odin:635). Empirically verified: `harness replay advance_fire goldens/advance_fire.log.bin` prints 'FIRST DIVERGENCE at tick 600' (same for advance_block_sla and advance_block_legacy).
detail: The live/save path builds Demo_Replay without advance_gate_on, so gate demos sim gate-off; manifests/T1/T2 pin no-advance behavior. Standalone replay + drift use the gate-on config and diverge at tick 600; drift's advance_gate_flip passes vacuously.
recommended_fix: Add `advance_gate_on = demo.advance_gate_on` to run_demo's Demo_Replay literal, then re-bless advance_fire/advance_block_sla/advance_block_legacy goldens so they pin the gate firing/blocking.

title: Milestone window is never re-armed after a fire — a post-fire era can advance on the next tick without a fresh sustain window
detail: After a gate fire, tick >= window stays true and the ring retains pre-advance deltas, so the following era's SLA term can pass immediately (back-to-back advances). Latent only because the real 3-era catalog makes era 3 terminal (the era>=len(cat.eras) guard).
recommended_fix: On fire, reset era_gate's ring/windowed sums and store the era-start tick; have era_gate_sla_ok require (tick - era_start_tick) >= milestone_window_ticks before the SLA term can pass.
